title: gateway, gui: Claude for Microsoft 365 can use magpie over local HTTPS
body:
## What changes Claude for Microsoft 365's Word, Excel and PowerPoint add-ins can connect to magpie at `https://127.0.0.1:8787`. - adds an opt-in, loopback-only HTTPS listener that reuses the ordinary gateway's `Server.Handler` - exposes only `GET /v1/models`, `POST /v1/messages`, and their preflight on that listener - creates or reuses a normal named `Claude for Microsoft 365` gateway key, so limits, model/account restrictions, Routing and Usage work as they do for other callers - adds `https://pivot.claude.ai` only while Microsoft 365 support is enabled - answers credentialed CORS and Private Network Access preflight without changing other configured browser origins' response headers - adds Settings controls for the HTTPS endpoint, certificate state and key copy, translated in every language magpie currently ships The ordinary agent gateway remains HTTP and keeps its current address, so existing agent configuration does not change. ## Security boundary and lifecycle This PR intentionally adds a network listener and an optional macOS trust-store write, called out here for the community-PR safety review: - the listener binds only `127.0.0.1:8787`; it never binds a LAN interface - its route wrapper returns 404 for every route except `/v1/models`, `/v1/messages`, and preflight on those paths - every browser call from the allowed remote origin still needs an enabled named gateway key - the CA has a critical Name Constraints extension permitting only exact `localhost`, `127.0.0.1/32`, and `::1/128`, with `.localhost` subdomains excluded - the leaf covers only `localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, and `::1`; its private key is mode `0600` - the CA private key exists only while signing the leaf and is never written to disk - certificate generation does not trust the CA - automatic trust actions are exposed only on macOS; installation is an explicit click into the user's default keychain - macOS removal uses `security delete-certificate -t`, deleting both the certificate and its user trust setting - Windows and other systems show the certificate path for manual trust management; the Windows `certutil` path stays unavailable through the UI and API until it has been validated end to end with real Windows Office - no dependency, workflow, release script, Dockerfile, telemetry, or external service is added Turning support off commits the security boundary first: it saves `M365=false`, removes `https://pivot.claude.ai`, and stops the HTTPS listener. It then removes macOS certificate trust. A listener or trust cleanup failure is reported separately with manual cleanup guidance and cannot leave the setting or origin enabled. Disable also works when this Magpie is not serving the ordinary gateway. A failed enable—whether the ordinary gateway restart fails or the HTTPS listener does not start—rolls the setting and origin back to off. The named gateway key remains so a later enable can reuse it; it can still be revoked from Gateway keys. ## Subsystem behavior The current contract, platform behavior, lifecycle and failure semantics are documented in `docs/subsystems/m365.md` and linked from the subsystem index. The Microsoft 365 setting is machine-local under `Settings.KeepOwn`: sync or backup cannot start a listener on another computer or attach it to a key that is absent there. ## Verification Passed after rebasing onto `upstream/main` `674b6ca2`: ```text go test ./internal/gateway ./internal/gui -run 'TestM365|TestCORSSettingCannotDrift' -count=1 go test -race ./internal/gateway ./internal/gui -run 'TestM365|TestCORS' -count=2 go vet ./... GOOS=linux go vet -tags nogui ./... GOOS=windows go vet -tags nogui ./... GOOS=darwin go build -tags nogui ./... GOOS=linux go build -tags nogui ./... GOOS=windows go build -tags nogui ./... node --check internal/gui/assets/app.js node --check internal/gui/assets/i18n.js git diff --check ``` The M365 GUI regression passed in Chromium and WebKit at narrow width in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and German. It covers both the macOS automatic-trust controls and the non-macOS manual-certificate-path UI. A complete `go test -tags nogui ./...` was attempted, but was interrupted after more than four minutes in unrelated `internal/agent` tests. It did not report an M365 failure and is not claimed as a pass. ## Real-device evidence The real Claude add-in for PowerPoint on macOS was tested with `https://127.0.0.1:8787` and the dedicated Magpie key: it connected successfully, populated routed models, and sent a real prompt through Magpie. The screenshots are in [this PR comment](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/pull/1331#issuecomment-6138729782) and also show that the add-in's Gateway URL is editable. Windows Office real-device validation has **not** been run. Accordingly, automatic certificate install/removal remains disabled on Windows rather than being presented as verified support. --- ### 🎬 界面预览 CI 用这个 PR 的代码构建并真实运行 magpie（沙盒环境，配置了真实的 DeepSeek key），按改动自动操作、截图和录屏 · dc2d1ee · [运行记录](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/actions/runs/38842296865) **改动**（按代码）：在「设置 › 网络与共享」里新增「Microsoft 365」一节：一个开关，以及开启后显示的仅本机 HTTPS 地址、证书状态与信任操作、网关密钥复制和自动加入的允许网页。 > [!NOTE] > **沙盒里看不到**：沙盒大概不是 macOS，所以「信任证书 / 移除信任」这类自动信任按钮不会出现，只能看到证书路径那一行；Word、Excel、PowerPoint 里的 Claude 加载项本身在沙盒中无法运行，这个 HTTPS 监听器真正被加载项调用也看不到。另外若 127.0.0.1:8787 已被占用或本进程没有在提供网关，开启会失败并在这一节显示错误，而不是显示地址、证书与密钥。 [![播放录屏](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yetone/magpie/ui-previews/pr-1331/dc2d1ee/poster.png)](https://yetone.github.io/magpie/pr-1331/dc2d1ee/) ▶️ 点图打开录屏（可暂停、拖动）· [直接下载 mp4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yetone/magpie/ui-previews/pr-1331/dc2d1ee/preview.mp4) · 红线是鼠标轨迹，红色圆环是点击 #### 设置中的 Microsoft 365 一节 未开启时这一节显示的内容 #### 开启 Claude for Microsoft 365 开启后这一节显示的内容：地址、证书、密钥、允许的网页 点击「开启」后，Microsoft 365 这一节的显示 点「复制密钥」后这一节的样子
⚠️ 有 3 步没能照计划执行 - 设置中的 Microsoft 365 一节 · scroll : nothing visible matches #m365List (1 in the page) - 开启 Claude for Microsoft 365 · click #m365List button.text: nothing visible matches #m365List button.text with "复制密钥" (0 in the page) - 开启 Claude for Microsoft 365 · shot #status: nothing visible matches #status (1 in the page)

title: fix(web): exit cleanly on SIGTERM and SIGINT
body: ## Problem and reproduction During Railway image auto-updates, the old `magpie web` deployment was marked `CRASHED` immediately after `Stopping Container`, while the replacement deployment became `SUCCESS` seconds later. This generated misleading crash notifications for planned stops. Reproduced the process exit behavior locally using the exact released Linux/amd64 image, `magpie v0.1.1110`: `ghcr.io/yetone/magpie@sha256:15da0cb01bba31bf645ca0513b0f9524609e780c0b98f8bec6b5a0bc30670d60` The container ran `exec /magpie web --addr 0.0.0.0:3430 --no-open` with isolated disposable configuration and no external network access. Both the authenticated web page and `/magpie healthcheck` worked before stopping it. | Stop operation | Released binary | Fixed binary in the same image | | --- | --- | --- | | `docker stop --signal SIGTERM --timeout 10` | exit 2 | exit 0 | | `docker stop --signal SIGINT --timeout 10` | exit 2 | exit 0 | | `POST /api/window/quit` | exit 0 | exit 0 | All stops finished in under one second; none was OOM-killed or reached Docker's kill timeout. These are local Linux container results (Docker on macOS arm64, running linux/amd64), not a redeployment or end-to-end notification test on Railway. ## Behavior change The global `endProbesOnSignal` handler terminated `magpie web` on SIGINT/SIGTERM while `Web.Wait` only waited for the page's Quit action. Web now owns those two signals using the existing `ownSignals` handoff, as the desktop app and TUI already do. `webCmd` passes cancellation to `Web.Wait`. It closes the page listener, drains this process's gateway using the existing `stopServing` path and deadline, then returns to main for probe and session cleanup with a successful exit. SIGHUP retains its existing termination behavior. The page's Quit and restart-to-update also drain the gateway; a stop signal suppresses reexec, while a page-requested update keeps the existing arguments and run key. See the updated [GUI app shell shutdown contract](https://github.com/AmAzing129/magpie/blob/fix/web-signal-shutdown/docs/subsystems/gui-shell.md#browser-mode-shutdown), [`web_cli.go`](https://github.com/AmAzing129/magpie/blob/fix/web-signal-shutdown/web_cli.go), and [`internal/gui/web.go`](https://github.com/AmAzing129/magpie/blob/fix/web-signal-shutdown/internal/gui/web.go). This does not implement the independent-worker update handover discussed in #577, change Railway configuration, or disable crash notifications. ## Verification - Added `TestWebShutdown`, which runs the actual `main` entry point in isolated subprocesses and checks SIGTERM, SIGINT, SIGHUP and authenticated page Quit. - Before the fix, SIGTERM failed with `signal: terminated` and SIGINT with `signal: interrupt`; SIGHUP and page Quit controls passed. After the fix, all four pass. - The new regression plus the existing global signal tests passed with `-race -count=20`. - `go vet ./...`, native macOS `go build`, `CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -tags nogui`, and `GOOS=windows go build` passed. Windows was cross-compiled, not runtime-tested. - Local container comparison above passed against the released and fixed binaries. Temporary containers and their configuration were removed; no production credentials or services were used. - Full `go test -tags nogui ./...` passed with Go 1.26.8 and the real Bun 1.4.2 executable on PATH, with an isolated HOME and pinned Go caches. The first run used a mise Bun shim / Bun 1.3.14 and failed three plugin tests; using the runtime required by CI resolved those failures without changing plugin code. - No UI assets or appearance changed; no visual/UI suite was run. --- ### 🎬 界面预览 CI 用这个 PR 的代码构建并真实运行 magpie（沙盒环境，配置了真实的 DeepSeek key），按改动自动操作、截图和录屏 · 5a88cdc · [运行记录](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/actions/runs/37737544241) **改动**（按代码）：该 PR 只改 `magpie web` 的进程信号处理：SIGINT/SIGTERM 由 web 自己接管，关闭页面服务并排空网关后正常退出，SIGHUP 与页面「退出」行为不变；没有任何页面、样式、文案或交互的改变。 看了改动，没有找到用户能看到的界面变化，所以没有录制。详见[运行记录](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/actions/runs/37737544241)。

body: Follow-up to #1016 and the routing account-window support from #1833. ### Summary - Extend the existing Routing `cardOf` lookup to match local Usage cards with `kind: "plan"` for provider/key rows. - Show the plan 5-hour / 7-day windows and reset times directly on the existing Accounts and keys row, including while a lone Kimi Code key is answering or resting. - Reuse the existing `loadQuotas()` cache and request. This PR adds no quota section, polling loop, fetch path, or new translation string. - Keep current Usage windows out of kept-day history. ### Validation - New Kimi regression: Chromium and WebKit, English and Chinese, answering and resting, 1100px and 420px; 24/24 passed. It fails against unmodified main because the plan windows are absent. - Related Routing quota/window regressions: 136/136 passed across Chromium and WebKit. - `go test -tags nogui ./internal/gui -run "^$"`: passed (package compiles). - The full `internal/gui` Go test run reached an unrelated existing environment failure in `TestProxyCheckSaysAProxyPassedBy`: the endpoint returned HTTP 502 and the fixture proxy received no requests. --- ### 🎬 界面预览 CI 用这个 PR 的代码构建并真实运行 magpie（沙盒环境，配置了真实的 DeepSeek key），按改动自动操作、截图和录屏 · 1d4510d · [运行记录](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/actions/runs/39282152610) **改动**（按代码）：Routing 页读取 Usage 额度卡时不再只匹配订阅账号：供应商 Key 或供应商行也会匹配对应的 Plan 额度卡，使实时路由中的单个 Key 能带出 5 小时、7 天等额度窗口。 > [!WARNING] > **描述与代码不符**：描述提到的选择历史时保留额度区位置、失败或畸形读数的提示、共享 loadQuotas 缓存与并发合并、X-Magpie-Reading 重试，以及五种语言文案，都不是本 diff 实现的（diff 只改 cardOf 并新增测试）。 > [!NOTE] > **沙盒里看不到**：沙盒里没有 Kimi Code Key，当前实时路由是单个 Acme Cloud Key，且它没有 Plan 额度卡；Sub2API Relay 的额度窗口只在用量页出现。因此路由页无法显示本次改动后应出现的 5 小时/7 天额度窗口。 #### 路由页的 Key 额度窗口 路由页的实时路由与账号行

title: ci: race the whole provider package, not two of its tests
body:
## What changes

`.github/workflows/test.yml`'s **Race account usage** step, which ran only `-run '^Test(LoginUsage|SubscriptionUsageEachAccount)'`, becomes **Race provider** and runs every test in `./internal/provider/` under `-race`. Its comment says why. No app change.

## Why

The provider package's background readings outlive the call that starts them, and they read hooks and endpoints that tests swap. The race fixed in 655cdd0a (#1023) was one of these, and `TestAllowancesBeforeFirstReading` is another (#1155). Each lived in a test that the old `-run` filter never ran. Racing the whole package covers that class, not only the two known cases. It takes about 50s on an M-series Mac.

Supersedes #1127, which widens the filter by two tests.

## Verification

Run on upstream/main cda11d84 with the step's own command (macOS CI's form, empty tags), under a throwaway `HOME` with `GOCACHE`/`GOMODCACHE` pinned. "Reverted" means 655cdd0a's `internal/provider` changes were swapped in with `go test -overlay`.

```
go test -race -tags "" -count=1 [-overlay=revert.json] ./internal/provider/
```

| Provider code | Old step | New step |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 655cdd0a's fix reverted | pass 3/3 | **fail 3/3**, DATA RACE in `TestSubscriptionUsageServesStale` |
| current main | pass 3/3 | pass 3/3 |

The new step also passed with `-cpu 1,2 -count=40`.

**Which test fails without it:** none. This PR adds CI coverage. Without it, a regression of #1023 fails under `-race` locally but not in CI (table above).

Known: `TestAllowancesBeforeFirstReading` races with a refresh it leaves running. It passed at `-count=1` here, but under `-race -cpu 1,2 -count=300` it failed in 3 of 3 runs. #1155 fixes it; until that merges, this step may catch it.

Not run: Linux (gtk3 tags) and the Actions run itself.

title: Agent：接入 OpenClaw，配置主模型与备用链并提供安装入口
body: ## 行为变化 在 Agent 页和 CLI 中接入 OpenClaw，支持发现、安装入口、接入／断开，以及主模型与有序备用模型的配置。模型链编辑器保留在本 PR：主模型和备用列表共同决定 OpenClaw 的模型选择，是同一个接入功能的配置入口。 - 发现本机及 WSL 的 OpenClaw；未安装时在「安装其他 Agent」中提供官方安装脚本，展示不会执行安装器或创建配置。 - 写入 magpie 供应商、模型目录和默认模型，保留用户自己的供应商、频道及其他配置。主模型和备用模型支持 magpie 路由组及原生 provider/model，编辑后自动保存，可排序和清空；写入失败保留原值。 - 编辑默认／唯一 Agent 的有效模型，保留其他 Agent 的覆盖；断开时恢复未被外部修改的原值。逐会话选择不变。 - JSON/JSONC 保留注释与排版。其他 JSON5 语法在首次编辑时规范化并备份原文；断开后值一致则逐字节还原，值变化则保留用户修改并删除过期备份，下次接入重新备份当前原文。 - 遵循 OpenClaw 配置路径、`~` 展开及只读/Nix 标记；损坏配置和 `$include` 均拒绝写入。采用官方彩色图标，补齐中、英、繁中、日、德文案。 设计及源代码：[Agent wiring](https://github.com/GodD6366/magpie/blob/feat/openclaw-agent/docs/subsystems/agent-wiring.md)、`internal/agent/openclaw.go`、`internal/gui/api.go`、`internal/gui/assets/app.js`。 ## Review 修复与验证 当前 head：`bb5eca3e15cabf72d21fae2e86ab80c17a0777c8`，已合入上游 `5774c790bdd62533179b705a1dba8c19cff5d481`。 OpenClaw 修复（独立提交 `532d2125`）及本次合并结果： - 合并最新 main 时解决了唯一的脚本预算冲突：保留主线的 1,469,000 字节预算，OpenClaw 不再额外提高预算。合并后总量为 1,451,460 字节，app.js 为 1,261,359 字节，均在各自预算内。主线的窗口返回合并刷新与 OpenClaw 编辑器都保留。 - Sync 保留反向代理地址后，stash 的 provider `after` 现在从实际落盘内容读取，使记录与配置一致。Disconnect 能删除新建的 provider，或恢复用户原有的 provider。 - macOS/Linux 安装标签改为可翻译的 `script`；删除独立 npm 入口，仅提供会准备所需 Node.js 版本的官方安装脚本。 - 只读/Nix 标记通过 `at.getenv` 读取。状态/配置路径中的 `~` 按有效 OpenClaw home 展开，`OPENCLAW_HOME` 自身的 `~` 按系统 home 展开；共享环境变量校验也接受这些路径。WSL 继续忽略 Windows 的路径与只读标记。 - 对应行为已更新到 Agent wiring 设计文档。 ### 本次冲突合并检查 - 唯一手动冲突为 `internal/gui/core_budget_test.go`，完整保留主线预算；相对新 main，该文件已无差异。合并未另加产品行为。 - `go test -tags nogui ./... -count=1 -timeout=45m -p 4` 全部通过，64 个有测试的包成功；Agent 351.754 秒、Gateway 404.356 秒、GUI 72.254 秒。 - macOS/arm64、Linux/arm64 nogui、Windows/arm64 的 `go vet` 和构建全部通过。 - Playwright 1.63.0 的 Chromium 定向 GUI 检查串行执行，33 项通过，0 失败：`openclaw-models`、`agent-update-all`、`window-back-once`。模型链覆盖五种语言、web/desktop、420/1100px；窗口返回刷新覆盖中英文及 window/panel。 - WebKit 本轮未能完成：可用运行时出现加载/等待按钮稳定超时；独立 HTML 单按钮（不加载 Magpie）也复现相同点击超时，阻塞的运行已中止。早先与 Go 检查并行时，Chromium 的更新用例另有一次滚动位置断言 30 vs 0；完整独立串行运行通过，未修改源码或测试来绕过断言。 - `gofmt -l` 无输出，`git diff --check` 通过；相对新 main 的 27 个 PR 文件通过 UTF-8/NUL 检查。未运行完整 GUI 套件及物理 Linux/Windows/WSL 验收，未改变本地运行中的应用或真实配置。 ### 上一轮 Review 修复检查（b08e48fe） - title: redact, gateway, usage: what the request archive and the OTLP bodies …
body:
redact, gateway, usage: what the request archive and the OTLP bodies keep loses a masking rule of the user's own (#195)

## What is wrong

A rule the user added in Settings → Privacy for a key format magpie's own rules
do not know — a relay's `rz_` key, say — went out of what the **vendor** was
sent and stayed in what magpie **kept**.

`redact.Scrub`, `ScrubHeader` and `ScrubJSON` ran with `Options{Secrets: true}`
and nothing else, so `Options.Rules` never reached them. The vendor side goes
through `redact.MaskJSON(body, redactionOptions())`, which carries the full
options — so the two halves of the same request disagreed about what a secret
is. Three "keep, don't send" paths held the value in plaintext:

- the request archive's bodies both ways, its headers, its query and its error lines;
- the bodies the gateway's OTLP export carries;
- the bodies an agent's own session files give that export.

The user's masking words and personal data went the same way: the masking covers
them, the scrubbing dropped them.

## What changed

`redact` now takes the options it is given: `ScrubWith`, `ScrubHeaderWith` and
`ScrubJSONWith`, with `Scrub`, `ScrubHeader` and `ScrubJSON` as thin wrappers
passing `Options{Secrets: true}` exactly as before — every existing caller's
behaviour is unchanged, and `TestScrubWithOptions` pins both the new entries
and that the old ones still take only the secrets out.

- `Settings.Redaction()` puts the settings → `redact.Options` mapping in one
  place, so `redactionOptions()` and the scrubbing paths cannot drift apart.
- `scrubOptions()` is the archive's and the OTLP bodies' options: what the user
  asked masked, **and** every secret beside it, masking on or not. What they
  keep goes to the user's own bucket or their collector, never to a vendor, so
  a secret goes from it either way — which is the archive's existing contract,
  kept.
- The archive's `upload` takes every part of what it uploads out with those
  options: the error and fallback lines, the query, both sides' headers, both
  sides' bodies.
- `bodyForExport` (an agent's session export) and `sessionBody` (the OTLP
  bodies an agent's own files give) read the same options.

### One semantic boundary this PR does **not** touch

A user's masking rule still only takes effect while *Mask secrets* is on: that
is `internal/settings/settings.go`'s documented meaning and what
`internal/redact/rules_test.go` and `internal/gateway/redact_test.go`'s
`rules_off` case pin. Making a rule work on its own is a policy change for the
maintainer, so this PR leaves it alone and forces only the secrets on the
keep-don't-send side.

## Semantic change

- Before: `redact.Scrub*` took magpie's own secrets out and nothing else, so
  the archive and the OTLP bodies kept a user rule's match in plaintext.
- After: those paths carry the user's own rules, words and personal data, and
  the secrets on top of them.
- Reference: the Privacy settings and `Redaction` in
  `internal/settings/settings.go`; implementation `ScrubWith` and friends in
  `internal/redact/scrub.go`, `scrubOptions` in `internal/gateway/redact.go`,
  `upload` in `internal/gateway/archive.go`, `bodyForExport` in
  `internal/gateway/capture.go`, `sessionBody` in `internal/usage/otel_sessions.go`.

No reference picks this up: `docs/reference.md`'s OTLP export section describes
what a trace carries and says "Header checks never upload history or bodies",
but neither it nor any `docs/subsystems/` page states what masking a kept body
takes out — the request archive is not documented at all. So there is no
reference to correct here. If you would rather one exist for it, say so and I
will write it.

## Verification

`TestArchiveKeepsTheUsersRules` (masking on and off),
`TestBodyForExportKeepsTheUsersRules` and `TestSessionBodyKeepsTheUsersRules`
fail without the change: the archived reply, the archived request with masking
off, the exported body and the session body each hold
`rz_RelayKey1234567` in plaintext. `TestScrubWithOptions` holds the new entries
and that the old ones still take only the secrets out.

The tests use an `rz_` prefix no built-in rule knows, so a match by an internal
rule cannot make them pass for the wrong reason; the masking on/off subtests
cover the placeholder and the direct-scrub paths separately.

- `go test -tags nogui` for `internal/redact`, `internal/usage` (whole package)
  and the archive, capture and redaction tests of `internal/gateway`;
- `go vet -tags nogui` on redact, gateway, usage and settings;
- gofmt on LF-normalized copies of each changed file, the worktree being CRLF;
  `go build -tags nogui` for `GOOS=windows`, `GOOS=darwin` and `GOOS=linux`.
- `internal/gateway`'s own suite (about 13 minutes here) is unaffected but for
  one failure that is the same on the base commit:
  `TestSweepBridgeProjectsTakesOnlyTheBridgesFolders`, which needs a symlink
  privilege this Windows box does not grant. That was the only `--- FAIL` in the
  whole run, and it fails identically against the unpatched base.
- Real use: the archive path was not exercised against a real archive bucket.
  The OTLP bodies were checked at `sessionBody`'s level, not against a live
  collector.

`TestScrubWithOptions` is the one test of the four that cannot run on the base
commit by itself: it names `ScrubWith` and its siblings, which this PR is what
adds, so on the base the package does not build. To get a real answer for it I
ran it on a scratch copy of the base with those three names defined as plain
delegation to the base's own `Scrub` / `ScrubHeader` / `ScrubJSON` — the base's
semantics, options dropped, nothing faked — and it failed on the same symptom.
The other three tests need no such copy: they fail on the base as it stands.

title: library: desktop.ini and Thumbs.db are no more an edit of a skill tha…
body:
library: desktop.ini and Thumbs.db are no more an edit of a skill than .DS_Store is

## What is wrong

A skill given to an agent as a copy (#896) sits in a folder the user opens in a
file manager: Explorer writes `desktop.ini` and `Thumbs.db` into it, Finder
`.DS_Store`. Four walkers of a skill's files each had **its own** list of what
isn't the skill:

- `hashDir` left all three in — so the file manager's own bytes changed the skill's hash;
- `treeOf` and `readSkill` left `.DS_Store` out but not `desktop.ini` or `Thumbs.db`;
- `copyDir` wrote whatever the source folder held.

So a copy with Explorer's files in it read as **edited**: the library took them
into its own folder, every agent was given a copy again, the page said the copy
differed from the library's, and a bundle carried them to another computer with
the skill.

While fixing it: `hashDir` and `readSkill` answered `.git` with `return nil`
rather than `filepath.SkipDir`, which kept walking *into* it — `.git`'s contents
were being hashed as part of the skill.

## What changed

`SkipInSkill`, in `skill_edits.go` where the list already was, now holds all of
them — magpie's own mark, `.git`, `.DS_Store`, `desktop.ini` and `Thumbs.db`,
compared without regard to case — and `hashDir`, `treeOf`, `readSkill` and
`copyDir` all walk by it, so a hash, a tree, a copy and a bundle agree on what a
skill is. The two `.git` walkers now answer `filepath.SkipDir`.

## Semantic change (Library)

- Before: a skill's hash, tree, copy and bundle each disagreed about what was
  part of the skill, so Explorer's or Finder's own files made a copy read as
  edited and were carried into the library and into bundles.
- After: one list decides it for all four, so a copy with the file manager's
  files in it reads as current and the files are left where they are.
- Reference: [`docs/subsystems/library.md`](docs/subsystems/library.md) (updated
  in this PR — the copy's hash contract is where this belongs);
  implementation `SkipInSkill` in `internal/library/skill_edits.go`, and its four
  callers in `skillcheck.go`, `skills.go`, `carry.go`.

## Verification

Verified on Windows, where Explorer's names are the ones written.

- Without the change `TestSkillCopyIgnoresExplorerMetadata` fails with
  `the file manager's files made the copy look edited: [claude]`; its assertions
  run past that one find the library's own folder and codex's copy holding
  `desktop.ini`, `Thumbs.db` and `THUMBS.DB`, and the library's skill kept with
  the backups for the edit.
- `TestCarryLeavesExplorerMetadataOut` fails with `the bundle carries .DS_Store`
  and the two Explorer names.
- Both pass with it. `go test -tags nogui ./internal/library`,
  `go vet -tags nogui ./...` and the windows, darwin and linux builds pass.

## Not in this PR

#916 is a different bug with a different root cause and is untouched here.

body: ## What changes Add Reasonix local conversations and retained native usage to Magpie's existing session subsystem. Reasonix remains an Agent; no subscription/provider plugin or request-path changes are introduced. The earlier revision was too narrow: it read legacy transcripts and reported canonical stores as unsupported. This revision actually reads the canonical stores instead of substituting an empty-state warning. - Legacy message JSONL and 1.x turn ledgers remain supported. - Published 2.29.0 transcript/wire captures cover human raw input, assistant messages without timestamps, retained usage, per-process telemetry and fresh-process resume sequence epochs. - Canonical `events/v3`, `linear/v3`, `linear/v3.1` and `linear/v4` are decoded read-only. Global/project `sessions-v*` and Studio `desktop-sessions-v*/by-id` are discovered by manifest codec, not directory version. The v5 directory uses the v4 codec. - Complete JSONL commits and checksummed RX4F/Zstandard transactions alone become visible. Torn/in-progress tails are ignored until committed; malformed boundaries, digest failures and unknown mandatory events are reported. - Content-addressed payloads verify length/SHA-256 and path confinement. Canonical complete/upsert/retract/history replacement is projected; provider context changes do not erase UI history. - Explicit imported legacy sources keep their retained usage under the canonical session identity, without a second conversation or duplicated cold-cache totals. - Native sessions reach List, management, stats aggregation and transcript HTTP handlers. Large transcripts resolve final identity/order first and materialize only the shared display window. Summary caches retain aggregates, not full transcript bodies. - Diagnostics now describe actual unknown/unreadable data, rather than rejecting every v4/v5 directory. Obsolete/Studio catalogs that the CLI cannot select are viewable read-only. ## Usage boundary Canonical Reasonix currently uses an in-memory turn ledger and daily provider stats without a session identity. Those global records cannot be joined exactly to individual conversations by timestamp alone. Explicit manual heuristic recovery is described below; it is separate from the normal reader. These conversations are visible with partial native usage history; explicit retained session receipts are counted, and new Magpie gateway requests retain their independent gateway accounting. Missing attribution is never presented as known zero or invented per-session spend. ## Producer evidence - `testdata/reasonix-2.29.0`: files emitted by the published 2.29.0 native host, including a fresh resumed process against a loopback fake provider. - `testdata/reasonix-stores`: all four canonical codecs emitted by Reasonix's source producer at `4a050542`, with synthetic public input and a real external payload object. This is codec producer coverage, not a claim that every frontend was driven interactively. - Authorized read-only local history check: 19 store directories decoded without an error; 16 nonempty native sessions, including 8 active within seven days, are visible through the actual session summary. No private transcript is included in the PR. ## Verification at this PR head - `go test -tags nogui ./internal/sessions ./internal/gui` passes at `442c7130`. - Canonical regression tests cover all codecs, Studio layout, a future-number directory with a known codec, external payloads, committed/torn resume append, upsert/retract, context versus history replacement, unknown required events, corrupted objects, linked imported usage and cold replay. - Real HTTP handlers verify native list/manage/transcript responses. - Focused canonical race tests pass in the integrated release lane. Chromium language/layout checks pass; changed diagnostic expectations were corrected and rechecked. The standalone WebKit automation baseline remains unverified and is not counted as passing. - Read-only isolated local summary measurement: cold about 2 s, warm 10 ms; native transcript about 2.4 s for the shared cut window. This is not a full production page benchmark. The 26 review perspectives were reapplied as an author self-review, including producer compatibility, identity/attribution, partial tails, private data isolation, actual user path, scale, integration and installation/runtime separation. This does not claim exhaustive proof or independent review. Owning contract: [Reasonix sessions](docs/subsystems/reasonix-sessions.md). The integrated BYOK release v0.1.1108-22-gcb8966fd (Build 2190) has passed its full release gates and is installed on the local Mac with controlled configuration hashes unchanged. Native UI-controller startup currently fails; the running App restart and production-page observation are explicitly still pending, so no live UI completion is claimed. --- ### 🎬 界面预览 CI 用这个 PR 的代码构建并真实运行 magpie（沙盒环境，配置了真实的 DeepSeek key），按改动自动操作、截图和录屏 · 747b479 · [运行记录](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/actions/runs/37883651495) **改动**（按代码）：这个 PR 给会话子系统接入了 Reasonix：用量 › 会话页在存在无法读取的 Reasonix 存储时，把统计行（#sessNote）和空列表文案换成兼容性提示；用量历史不完整的会话会在会话行和会话详情里显示「用量历史不完整」及一行说明，并补上中/日/德翻译。 > [!NOTE] > **沙盒里看不到**：沙盒里没有安装 Reasonix，也没有它的会话文件或存储目录，所以 unsupported_reasonix 与 usage_incomplete 都不会为真：新增的「有 N 个 Reasonix 会话存储存在无法读取或未知的数据」提示和会话行/详情里的「用量历史不完整」都不会出现，Agent 筛选条里也没有 Reasonix 这一项。场景只能展示这些文案会落到的位置（会话统计行、会话行、会话详情），内容仍是沙盒里 Claude Code、Codex 等既有会话。 [![播放录屏](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yetone/magpie/ui-previews/pr-1033/747b479/poster.png)](https://yetone.github.io/magpie/pr-1033/747b479/) ▶️ 点图打开录屏（可暂停、拖动）· [直接下载 mp4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yetone/magpie/ui-previews/pr-1033/747b479/preview.mp4) · 红线是鼠标轨迹，红色圆环是点击 #### 用量 › 会话页的提示位置 用量 › 会话：会话统计行与列表 会话统计行：本次改动改的就是这一行的文案 #### 会话行与会话详情里的用量标记 会话列表中的一行：标题、模型、用量与费用 会话详情面板顶部：用量说明加在这一段的前面 ### Follow-up verification at 6765231f Merged current upstream main (6a809542) without dropping the upstream session pagination/count note or translations. title: gui: 直接开在 Usage 页时，请求存档的开关现在会画出来
body: ## 这是什么 Usage 页「请求」一栏右上角有请求档案的开关（`renderArchive` 画），它读的是模块级的 `providers`（`{providers, presets, gateway}`）。而 `show("usage")` 和 `load()` 的 usage 分支从来只拉用量、**不加载 providers**——providers 只在 providers / gateway / routing 三个视图里读。所以直接开在 Usage 页时（页面自己记的地址、刷新、别人发来的链接、 `magpie web --gateway`），模块级 `providers` 一直是 `null`， `box.hidden = !providers?.gateway` 恒为真，开关在**这一页的每一个 tab 上**都不出现。 先去过 Providers 或 Gateway 再点 Usage 就会加载它、开关也就正常——页面自己的测试一直是这么 走的（`request-archive.test.cjs` 和 `web-page.test.cjs` 都从 `?view=gateway` 进），所以这个 坏路径一直没被覆盖。 ## 改了什么 `show("usage")` 和 `load()` 的 usage 分支在拉用量的同时一并加载 providers 状态，和上面几个 视图的做法一致： * `show("usage")` 用兄弟调用点同样的写法报错（`loadProviders().then(back, …)`）。 * `load()` 里两个请求一起发（`Promise.all`），不是串行——回到窗口时少一趟往返。 * `renderLedger` 里那个同名局部变量（ledger 自己的供应商列表）**没有动**：JS 的函数作用域 是静态的，被调用的 `renderArchive` 读不到调用方的局部变量，它从来没有遮住任何东西。 给它改名只会让人以为遮住过。 ## 怎么验证的 - `node --check`（app.js）；`go vet`；`go build`（windows）。 - 新增用例「the archive's switch is drawn when the page opens on Usage」：直接 `?view=usage` 打开、点进「请求」，断言开关出现、`aria-checked=false`、tooltip 是 "先设置 s3://" 那句、并且和请求合计在同一行上。**它在 origin/main 的 app.js 上必挂** （开关不出现），在本分支上过（实测 8/8）。把 providers 那行加载去掉它也会挂。 - 本机演示实例（真实数据的只读使用）上过目：改动后进 Usage 页开关重新出现。 真实实例（127.0.0.1:3425）未受影响。 - 浏览器套件（chromium 与 webkit、en/zh）：`request-archive` 8/8、`request-archive-usage` 10/10、`web-page`、`usage-ledger` 34/34、`usage-ledger-chart` 18/18、`usage-fold`、 `usage-accounts`、`click-scroll` 18/18、`i18n-keys`、`ledger-hscroll` 6/6、 `usage-speed` 6/6 全绿。 - `request-archive-usage` 里那条 `a click moved the page: 860 to 861` 不是这个 PR 或 app 的 问题：测试助手 `reader.inView` 把底部被裁掉不到 1px 的目标当成可见，而开关出现后 `.led-head` 高了 4px，Fetch 按钮落在视野下方 0.59px，Playwright 自己滚了那 1px。已在 main 的 `70e7e366` 修好（只点完全在视野内的目标），本分支 rebase 到它之后该套件 5/5。 --- ### 🎬 界面预览 CI 用这个 PR 的代码构建并真实运行 magpie（沙盒环境，配置了真实的 DeepSeek key），按改动自动操作、截图和录屏 · 3b1f42d · [运行记录](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/actions/runs/37619964564) **改动**（按代码）：「用量」页的 show() 与 load() 两条路径现在都会一并读取供应商状态（load() 里与用量并发），于是 renderArchive 画的请求存档开关不再因为模块级 providers 未加载而在「请求」栏缺席。 > [!NOTE] > **沙盒里看不到**：沙盒跑的是本分支的构建，只能拍到修复后开关出现的样子；修复前（直接打开『用量』页时「请求」栏没有这个开关）无法在同一实例里重现。 [![播放录屏](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yetone/magpie/ui-previews/pr-1017/3b1f42d/poster.png)](https://yetone.github.io/magpie/pr-1017/3b1f42d/) ▶️ 点图打开录屏（可暂停、拖动）· [直接下载 mp4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yetone/magpie/ui-previews/pr-1017/3b1f42d/preview.mp4) · 红线是鼠标轨迹，红色圆环是点击 #### 用量页「请求」栏的请求存档开关 「用量」页打开时的「概览」栏 「请求」栏顶部这一行 「请求」栏上的请求存档开关及其提示 同一行左侧的请求合计

title: usage: forecast whether an allowance lasts to its reset
body: The Usage page shows each allowance's readings and what is left, but users still have to estimate whether their current use will last until the next reset. This adds a forecast to each observed allowance window and shows its verdict on the Usage page and in the tray. Rebased onto current main as one commit (`44e1789a`, on main `cb05dc2d`). Main has rewritten the allowance cards since this PR's base (packUsage, `quotaFit`, the past-cycle picker, colorblind dashes, Pace, `quotaEta`), so the verdict goes onto main's own code. The PR's earlier per-window plots and its ahead/behind chip are gone; main's Pace already says ahead or behind. ### Behavior - **Forecast.** `QuotaHistories` gives each line a forecast derived from the window's whole stored series (`internal/provider/quota_forecast.go`). It compares the current cycle's rate with an even burn. For windows of two days or more it also uses the well-covered past cycles, and the more conservative result wins. The state is `ok`, `spent` or `none`. A clear early burn warns before 8% of the cycle has passed. Cycle breaks use main's `newCycle`. The forecast is derived on read and is never persisted or synced. - **Usage card.** `quotaVerdict` adds "Lasts to reset · 1.3×", "Runs out in …" or "Used up" on a line of its own after each window's reset line and Pace. A "history" marker shows when past cycles decided the answer. No verdict is shown for a missing forecast, state `none`, no readings, a brief account or a past cycle. Remote gateway-key cards and Sub2API key windows (#1004) get the verdict too. - **Tray.** One compact line per window under the rings. It wraps rather than being cut off, so the German line with both the multiplier and the history marker stays whole at 440px. - **Strings** in zh, zh-TW, ja and de. - **Size budget.** `core_budget_test`: `app.js` 1,250,000 → 1,254,000 bytes (1,252,431 with the verdict). The verdict is shared by the Usage cards and the tray, which stay in the core. The core total stays within main's 1,447,000 (#2612). The subsystem reference is updated in `docs/subsystems/providers-accounts.md`. ### Validation macOS, Go 1.27.2, Node with Playwright 1.62.1, at `44e1789a` on origin/main `cb05dc2d`: - `go vet ./internal/provider ./internal/gui`, `GOOS=linux -tags nogui` and `GOOS=windows` builds, `gofmt -l internal/`, `node --check` on `app.js`, `git diff --check`: clean. - `go test -race -count=1 -run 'Forecast|QuotaHist' ./internal/provider`: ok. - `go test ./internal/gui` (temporary HOME): all ok except `TestProxyCheckSaysAProxyPassedBy` (HTTP 503 from the sandboxed network) and `TestMainWindowCorners` (macOS title bar). Both fail the same way on origin/main on this machine. - Every `quota-*`, `usage-*` and `panel-*` file plus `i18n-keys`, `gui-zh-tw`, `gui-de`, `gui-ja` and `balance-curve` (concurrency 2): 969 of 1000 pass. `quota-forecast` passes in full. None of these fixtures carries a forecast. Earlier, at `c51affd1` (on main `1eba266a`): - `go test -timeout 45m ./internal/provider` (temporary HOME): ok. - `quota-forecast.test.cjs` covers Chromium and WebKit, en/zh/ja/de, light and dark, Usage at 1180 and 560px, and the tray at 440px (plus 260px for the wrap): 26/26, twice. Each check was confirmed by breaking the code on purpose and watching it fail. The breaks were: removing the past-cycle guard, showing a verdict for a missing forecast, removing the 10× cap, replacing the tray's wrap with an ellipsis (fails at 260px in German), and making `quotaWindowLine` ignore a pool window's own name (fails the "Every model" toggle case). title: routing: 「Weekly pace」|「重置前用完」中文名改为「额度均衡」，使中文更清楚直观
body:
#517 合并后，中文名「重置前用完」带的意思并不明确直观，对功能的说明不容易理解：按紧迫度、先用快到期的，那是「智能」已经在做的事。
Weekly pace 真正的目的，是让每个账号的周额度都按各自的重置时间匀速用掉，不让某一个账号提前见底，这样后面更多的 5 小时窗口里都还有多个账号可用。该算法，在重置时间差不多的情况下相当于最少使用，差别较大时相当于智能，所以哪个都不准确。

这个 PR 只改文案，不动路由逻辑：

- 中文选项名：重置前用完 → **额度均衡**（Routing 页的路由说明前缀一并改）。
- 中文说明：「根据剩余周额度和重置时间分配使用，避免过早耗尽某个账号的周额度，让后续更多个 5 小时窗口仍有多个账号可用。」其后保留原有的细节（90% 以上的排后、只有 5 小时额度的账号、Key 的排法）。
- 英文名保持 **Weekly pace**，说明改为先讲它做什么：“uses each account's week up evenly until it renews — the most of its week left per hour first — so later five-hour windows still have several accounts”，长度和原来差不多。
- 日文「週ペース」、德文「Wochentempo」的名字保留，说明随英文重新翻译。

title: agent, gui: Codex 的 CLI 在 Windows 上能更新了，并且会说明它只是 CLI
body:
## 现象 Windows 上 Codex 的 CLI 没有更新按钮：版本能显示，但提示「无法判断安装方式，请按原安装方式更新」。 根因是 PATH 命中的是 npm prefix 里的原生 `codex.exe`（358 MB），不是 npm 写的 `codex.cmd`： - `fromNodeModules` 先看 exe 路径里有没有 `node_modules//` —— exe 在 prefix 里，不在包里； - 再看它是不是一个小 shim —— `shimNames` 按大小（>64 KB）直接拒了。 于是 `howInstalled` 返回 nil，`Via`/`Command`/`Latest`/`Update` 全空。 ## 改了什么 1. **`shimExeNames`**：exe 自己说明不了来历，就看它旁边那个 npm 写的 `.cmd`/`.ps1` 有没有点出包名。点了就是 npm 装的。 2. **更新时把 exe 一起更新**：`npm install -g` 换掉的是包里的文件，而 prefix 的 `.exe` 是它的硬链接，会继续指向旧字节 —— 更新跑了、版本没动，magpie 会报「还是旧版本」。现在更新前先找出这个硬链接对象，更新后把它重链到 npm 装的新文件（旧的先改名让开，因为 Windows 允许重命名正在运行的 exe 但不允许删；link 失败会把旧的放回去）。**不是硬链接的副本一律不碰。** 3. **说明它只是 CLI**：Codex 那一行的版本提示后面加「这是命令行版本，不是 Codex 桌面版（桌面版由它自己更新）」，中/日/德都补了译文。 ## 关于那个 exe 是谁放的 我把能试的都试了一遍 —— 全新 `npm install -g`、`codex.cmd --version`、原生 `codex.exe --version`（含把 prefix 放上 PATH）、`codex update`、`codex doctor`，临时目录和非临时目录各一遍 —— **都不会在 prefix 里产生 `codex.exe`**。 它是用户自己放的：Windows 上 Node 的 `spawn` 不带 `shell: true` 跑不了 `.cmd`/`.ps1`，要程序化调用 codex 就得有个真 exe，把包里的原生 exe 硬链接进 prefix 是标准解法。 所以这不是 Codex 的官方布局，但它是**真实且常见**的布局；而且只要 magpie 给了按钮，就必须能把它一起更新掉，否则那个按钮是坏的。 （顺带一个旁证：重链之后 `codex doctor` 从 `install method: other · managed by npm: no` 变成了 `install method: npm · managed by npm: yes`。） ## 验证 改动前必挂、改动后必过： - `TestUpdateCLIWindowsHardLink`：造一个硬链接到包内文件的 `.exe`，模拟 npm 换掉包内文件。**把重链那行拿掉跑，报的正是** `Codex is still 0.146.0 after npm install …; 0.160.0 is out`；加上就过。反例（`.exe` 是副本不是链接）确认 magpie 不动它。 - `TestHowInstalledWindowsNpmExe` / `TestHowInstalledWindowsShim` 过。 - `go build ./...`、`go vet ./internal/agent/` 干净。 - `node --test internal/gui/tests/cli-update.test.cjs` 5/5 过（含新增的简介断言与中文断言）。 Windows 上真跑了一遍（独立 npm prefix + 真 `@openai/codex@0.146.0` + 手工硬链接 + 独立 magpie 实例，端口避开在用的那个）： | 点击前 | 更新中 | 更新后 | |---|---|---| | ![点击前](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wizzy-yang/magpie/pr-930-shots/1-before.png) | ![更新中](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wizzy-yang/magpie/pr-930-shots/2-updating.png) | ![更新后](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wizzy-yang/magpie/pr-930-shots/3-after.png) | 行内特写： | 前 | 中 | 后 | |---|---|---| | ![前](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wizzy-yang/magpie/pr-930-shots/1-row-before.png) | ![中](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wizzy-yang/magpie/pr-930-shots/2-row-updating.png) | ![后](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wizzy-yang/magpie/pr-930-shots/3-row-after.png) | `Codex 0.146.0` + `↓ 更新到 0.160.0` → `⟳ 更新中…` → `Codex 0.160.0`，药丸消失，状态栏 `Codex 已更新到 0.160.0`。磁盘上 `prefix\codex.exe --version` 变成 `codex-cli 0.160.0`，SHA1 与包内新二进制一致，仍是硬链接，没留 `.old`。 ## 已知的、与本次无关的失败 `internal/agent` 在 Windows 本机有 8 个既有失败（符号链接权限 + 真实 `~/.codex` 依赖），改动前后完全同一批（用 `git stash` 对照过），CI 三平台是绿的。 ## 文档 `cliupdate` 不是 `docs/subsystems/` 里记的子系统，没有文档需要跟着改。 --- ### 🎬 界面预览 CI 用这个 PR 的代码构建并真实运行 magpie（沙盒环境，配置了真实的 DeepSeek key），按改动自动操作、截图和录屏 · de51876 · [运行记录](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/actions/runs/37350550517) **改动**（按代码）：Agents 页里 Codex 行的版本号上多了一句悬停说明：app.js 把后端新给的 note 拼到版本号元素的 title 末尾，i18n 为它补了中文、日文、德文；其余改动（Windows 上从原生 .exe 旁的 npm .cmd 认出安装方式、更新后把 .exe 重新硬链接到 npm 装的文件）都在后端，界面上没有新增元素或按钮。 > [!NOTE] > **沙盒里看不到**：这句话只写进版本号元素的 title（浏览器原生悬停提示），截图/录屏里看不到文字本身，只能看到悬停状态；PR 描述真正的现象——Windows 上 npm 安装的 Codex 出现「更新到 x」按钮、以及更新后 .exe 重新硬链接——需要 Windows 上的 codex.exe 与 npm 的 codex.cmd 并排这套布局，这台 Linux 沙盒里没有，看不到。另外如果沙盒里 Codex CLI 没被检测到，版本号本身不会出现，这句说明也就无从显示。 [![播放录屏](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yetone/magpie/ui-previews/pr-930/de51876/poster.png)](https://yetone.github.io/magpie/pr-930/de51876/) ▶️ 点图打开录屏（可暂停、拖动）· [直接下载 mp4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yetone/magpie/ui-previews/pr-930/de51876/preview.mp4) · 红线是鼠标轨迹，红色圆环是点击 #### Codex 版本号上的悬停说明 Agent 页列表：先看这里有哪些 Agent 展开后的 Agent 列表，看 Codex 这一行 Codex 行：本机没有检测到 Codex CLI，所以只有名字和模型选择，没有版本号（也就没有那句悬停说明）

title: gui: a moved built-in whose plugin offers several ways shows every way
body: ## 这个 PR 修什么 `internal/gui/assets/app.js`： ```js function pluginMethod(sub, site) { if (!sub.moved) return undefined; const label = (sub.sites || []).find(([id]) => id === site)?.[1]; const at = label ? sub.plugin.methods.findIndex((m) => (m.label || "").includes(label)) : -1; return at < 0 ? 0 : at; // ← 多种方式且无 site 标签时 → 0 } ``` `startPluginSignIn()` 只在 `method == null` 时才发问： ```js if (method == null) { if (ms.length > 1) { signing = { agent: sub.agent, state: "method" }; return renderProviders(); } method = 0; } ``` 于是「有多种登录方式、又没有 `sites` 条目可区分」的插件，第二种方式被隐藏。WorkBuddy 是发现这个问题的案例（`WorkBuddy account (browser)` 与 `WorkBuddy desktop's sign-in` 不是同一个 sign-in），但缺陷是通用的 —— CLI 在这种情形下本来就是发问的，GUI 是那个异类。 ## 修复 ```js const at = label ? sub.plugin.methods.findIndex((m) => (m.label || "").includes(label)) : -1; - return at < 0 ? 0 : at; + if (at >= 0) return at; + // one way: that is the way. More than one: the plugin's own list is the + // answer, and startPluginSignIn puts the question. + return (sub.plugin.methods || []).length > 1 ? undefined : 0; ``` 其余行为不变：site 命中的方式仍然优先；单方式插件仍然一击直入、不弹选择器；插件自有 provider（未迁移）仍然发问。 ## 文件 ``` internal/gui/assets/app.js +9 -1 internal/gui/tests/plugin-method-picker.test.cjs +138 (new) ``` ## 测试 ``` node --test internal/gui/tests/plugin-method-picker.test.cjs BROWSER=chromium 6 pass / 0 fail (en + zh) node --test internal/gui/tests/plugin-moved-signin.test.cjs (回归) 3 pass / 0 fail (ZCode / Factory / Cursor 行为不变) ``` 新测试把这条规则的三个分支都固定下来：WorkBuddy 会显示**两种**方式、按插件自己的顺序、按钮上带插件自己的索引（`data-method="0"` / `"1"`），选第二种时发出 `method: 1`、选第一种时发出 `method: 0`；单方式插件（Factory）仍然直通、不弹选择器；site 命名插件（ZCode）仍然按 site 选择。 `internal/gui/tests/plugin-moved-signin.test.cjs` 未做改动即通过，这正是 `at >= 0` 排序的意义所在。 ## 关联 这个 GUI 修复与 `magpie-community/plugins` 的 workbuddy sealed-signin 支持是**两件独立的事**：插件那边让 `desktop's sign-in` 能读 WorkBuddy 5.6+ 的加密登录态（[PR #18](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins/pull/18)），这边让 GUI 把它显示出来。两边可独立合并。 在真实环境（WorkBuddy 5.6.2 + magpie 0.1.817）验证过：`magpie plugin login workbuddy 2` 可用；GUI 修复后两个按钮正常出现，且原 browser 方式保持可点。 --- ### 🎬 界面预览 CI 用这个 PR 的代码构建并真实运行 magpie（沙盒环境，配置了真实的 DeepSeek key），按改动自动操作、截图和录屏 · 1cf3d4a · [运行记录](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/actions/runs/37193037280) **改动**（按代码）：app.js 的 pluginMethod 在「已迁移的内置 Agent、其插件提供多种登录方式、又没有可区分它们的 site 标签」时不再固定返回 0，而是返回 undefined，让 startPluginSignIn 弹出登录方式选择器；site 命中的方式与只有一种方式的插件行为不变。 > [!NOTE] > **沙盒里看不到**：登录方式选择器只在「已迁移的内置 Agent 的插件提供多种登录方式」时出现（如 WorkBuddy 的 browser 与 desktop 两种 sign-in）。沙盒里只有 DeepSeek 一个供应商、没有任何插件 provider，也没有这类 Agent，所以选择器本身无法真实弹出，只能展示它会出现的那个位置（供应商面板的账号区）。 [![播放录屏](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yetone/magpie/ui-previews/pr-777/1cf3d4a/poster.png)](https://yetone.github.io/magpie/pr-777/1cf3d4a/) ▶️ 点图打开录屏（可暂停、拖动）· [直接下载 mp4](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yetone/magpie/ui-previews/pr-777/1cf3d4a/preview.mp4) · 红线是鼠标轨迹，红色圆环是点击 #### 供应商面板中的登录方式位置 供应商页面：沙盒里只有 DeepSeek 一个供应商 供应商面板的账号区——提供多种登录方式的内置插件，每种方式会在这里依次列出

title: accounts: do not restore a forgotten CLI identity after a failed status check
body: An explicit account change invalidates the CLI identity, but if the next ask fails, `forget()` still serves the previous `user`/`plan`/`ok`. Its disk entry can also restore that account on restart. This update clears the served fields and removes only that CLI's persisted identity; the other CLI's identity stays intact. An ordinary failed background refresh continues to preserve the last answer. Refreshed against upstream `a15e576564cb90d4d027e8b8cb7821472de0a3fc`. The earlier unanswered-ask handling, including interpreting Devin output before its exit status, is already on current main (`askDevinStatusAt`). The update keeps that implementation and adds explicit signed-in/signed-out nonzero-exit coverage instead of reintroducing the old parser. The remaining production change is `cliIdentity.forget`, shared by the built-in Cursor and Devin identity caches; moved plugin accounts use their own identity paths. Regression evidence: on unmodified current-main production code, `TestCLIIdentityForgetThenUnanswered` fails with `forget followed by failed ask served old account: "old@example.com" "Pro" true`; it passes after the fix. It also checks restart behavior and preservation of another CLI's disk entry. `TestCLIIdentityForgetDropsInflightAnswer` checks that a pre-invalidation ask cannot restore the old identity. The documented failure behavior is updated in `docs/subsystems/providers-accounts.md`. The first complete suite failed only in `internal/agent.TestPrimeAgent`: it expects no detected agent before writing config, but `Agent.Detected` correctly finds an installed `prime-agent` on PATH. This was independently reproduced on untouched upstream `a15e5765`. A separate test-only commit isolates PATH for that config-detection fixture; the test then passes with `-race`. No Prime Agent production behavior changes. Validation on the final tree, using Go 1.26.8: - `go test -tags nogui ./... -timeout=45m`: PASS (exit 0, 892.1s). - CLI identity / Devin status tests with `-race`: PASS. - Isolated `TestPrimeAgent` with `-race`: PASS. - `go vet ./...` (macOS), `GOOS=linux go vet -tags nogui ./...`, `GOOS=windows go vet ./...`: PASS. After the test-only isolation change, the affected agent package was vetted again for all three platforms: PASS. - macOS, Linux nogui and Windows builds: PASS. - Changed Go files formatted; `git diff --check`: clean. The initial short-timeout full run was intentionally stopped, not counted as a pass. The next full run exposed the Prime Agent fixture issue above; the final complete run after its fix passed. Tests use an isolated HOME with Go caches pinned. No real vendor account or GUI test was run; there is no UI change. Cross-platform builds/vet do not establish native Linux or Windows runtime behavior. --- ### 🎬 界面预览 CI 用这个 PR 的代码构建并真实运行 magpie（沙盒环境，配置了真实的 DeepSeek key），按改动自动操作、截图和录屏 · 5c80760 · [运行记录](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/actions/runs/38858349010) 这次没录成（skipped）。详见[运行记录](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/actions/runs/38858349010)。
